title: Content-to-asset coverage report
description: Contract for the generated coverage report: per-domain joins of normalized content references against the asset registry, with missing-name lists and unreferenced-file counts for conversion prioritization.

result.description: Build outcome marker; only successful builds write outputs.

inputs.description: Reference sources: normalized package files consumed with digests.

domains.description: Per-domain join results keyed by domain name (item_sprites, magic_sprites, sounds, images).

corpus.description: Corpus totals mirrored from the registry for join-rate context.

unreferenced.description: Present-but-unreferenced file counts per directory class.
